interpretation.BB_alone: Limited coverage and oracle on simple getters and constants only.
interpretation.BB_plus_Mockito: Adding Mockito-based oracle tests killed the 3 SURVIVED mutations from BB-only, raising test strength to 100% on covered code.
interpretation.BB_plus_Mockito_plus_Randoop: Randoop's random testing expanded line coverage from 28% to 60% but lowered test strength because Randoop's auto-generated assertions are shallow. Mutation score continued rising from 25% to 29%.

key_finding: Random testing trades assertion quality for coverage breadth. Combining manual category-partition tests (BB), mutation-driven oracle improvements (Mockito), and automated random testing (Randoop) produces the best mutation score in our experiments.

test_types_used.BB (Black-Box / Category Partition): Manually written from public API specification
test_types_used.Mockito-based oracles: Manual, designed after analyzing initial PIT survived mutations
test_types_used.LLM-generated: Generated by Microsoft Copilot Basic (separate experiment, not used in PIT due to OpenJPA 2.0.0-M3 API incompatibilities)
